name: Theater
overview: Scripture references to the theater, such as in Acts 19, reveal it as a place of public gathering and potential conflict, where believers like Paul’s companions faced opposition. While the theater itself is a neutral setting, believers are called to be the light of the world and to boldly proclaim the gospel everywhere, even in challenging environments. Ephesians exhorts Christians to avoid fellowship with the works of darkness, urging discernment and reproof rather than participation in unfruitful deeds. Thus, the biblical perspective encourages believers to engage the world with truth and courage, remaining separate from darkness while fulfilling the Great Commission.
